name: Velveted Chicken (Takeout-Tender)
desc: Thin-sliced chicken tenderized with baking soda and coated in cornstarch for takeout-style stir-fries.

source.title: Velveted Chicken (takeout-tender)
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps: Slice the chicken against the grain into thin strips, 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick.
Toss the chicken with the baking soda until evenly coated. Refrigerate 15 minutes.
Rinse well in a colander under cold water to remove any soda taste, then pat dry with paper towels.
Toss with the cornstarch to coat lightly.
Stir-fry or sauce it like any Chinese takeout dish, cooking until no pink remains and the thickest piece reads 165°F.
tips: Baking soda raises the pH so the proteins can't tighten up, which keeps the meat tender.
The cornstarch coating holds in moisture and helps sauce cling.
RecipeTin Eats uses much more baking soda (3/4 tsp per 8 oz for 20 minutes); this lighter ratio is less likely to turn the chicken spongy.
